name: qfd_coll_face_s0_regional_fb

pin_regs.reason: SAFE/TOK_REG registered owning roots; exact calendar neutral. PHY-up captured; no extra automatic data stages.

structural_change: Native regional-tree production S0 face, six actual SRAM macros and explicit roots for calendar, two-clock channels, four banks and PHY. Removes hybrid hard-entry purity restriction by implementing the real sequential regions, not replacing a hard-child timing model. Local bank landing shares the bank SRAM tree; sticky fault returns use actual fixed-slot4/K2 rings. Larger frame and10.8um macro halos reserve landing and routing bands. Existing phase/calendar/CRC/data protocol maintained; status visibility is3edges later and must be measured. No threshold change/timing exception. Native source2 failure explicitly repaired: collision controls14groups, publication resets8bytegroups, write/version4groups, read-select4groups, eight final face-reset copies, all original stages retained. Source5 separates publication and seen address-select registers; source4 actually mapped33loads after aliasing the raw SRAM address. Identical capture edge, no extra stage.
slot_change_request: S0 native regional frame 1036.8 square; original734.4x864. Must reprice parent slot before binding.

job.purpose: S2 face PHY-region landing split D2K1 (QW-COLLIO3 stamp of s1_pl); non-critical; submit on PASS
